- Fresh lime juice (or kaffir lime leaves/zest) — bright acidity  
- Palm sugar (or brown sugar) — balances heat and salt  
- Thai bird’s eye chiles or chopped fresh chiles — heat and freshness  
- Extra red/green curry paste or roasted chili paste (nam prik pao) — concentrated flavor  
- Lemongrass and/or galangal — fragrant, citrusy/peppery notes  
- Fresh Thai basil or cilantro added at the end — herbal lift  
- A splash of soy or oyster sauce for extra umami (if you want less fishiness)  
- Toasted coconut or a pinch of ground roasted peanuts — texture and nuttiness  
- A dash of tamarind or lime for tartness to cut the richness
